thread:
Morgan: Ping 9A HyperLane updated terms: offering hybrid air/sea with new forwarder credit hold. Air ETA 3-5w, sea ETA 12-16w. New bit: option to route DOA returns into a bonded FRA consolidation hub (48h SLA) or courier direct-replace. Forwarder wants a refundable security deposit and an insurance uplift for declared value > $300k. PO in drive.

Sanjay: Bonded hub could speed replacements but adds customs paperwork (EORI + importer attestation). Do we have EORI on file for FRA consolidation?

Priya: We do for EU legal entity A, but the forwarder wants an additional importer-of-record attestation specifically for bonded warehousing. Legal will need to weigh liability.

Kevin: Cluster ops note: can we accept a 24-unit air tranche into eu-west without disrupting live lanes? If we do a 6-unit air canary we can validate rack handoff and thermal spool. Need transient quota for ~96h.

Amira (HyperLane): Yes canary possible. Forwarder credit-hold terms: refundable deposit equal to 2% of shipment value, prepaid bonded-hub fee if you choose consolidation. Bonded FRA hub gives 48h swap SLA for warrantied units when addendum signed; otherwise courier replacement (5-10d). We can pre-assign serial blocks and upload AWB + manifest tonight.

Morgan: Thanks. Finance: how does refundable deposit and insurance uplift impact runway vs full-air premium?

finance-bot: Quick calc: Full air premium + deposit/insurance uplift ~= +$520k. Hybrid (72 sea / 48 air) with 2% refundable deposit on air tranche and bonded hub fees ~= +$210k + refundable deposit. Recommend CFO OK for hybrid.

Sanjay: Operations checklist: need AWB + manifest CSV, EORI + importer attestation for FRA hub, HS docs, and a slot booking (dock-to-rack) window (6h contiguous). ops-bot, add these.

ops-bot: Checklist items added: "AWB + manifest CSV", "EORI + importer attestation for FRA bonded hub", "HS 8471 cert", "6h dock-to-rack slot booking".

Priya: Legal, please review the proposed bonded-hub addendum (liability cap, SLA credits for missed swaps). Also confirm whether deposit is refundable on claim timelines.

Amira (HyperLane): We'll DM proforma AWB + manifest and forward the bonded-hub addendum. We can also offer an alternative: route DOA returns to AMS depot (longer transit but lower deposit) if FRA attestation is a blocker.

Kevin: If we go FRA bonded hub, ops should plan for a 6-unit air canary first; roll rest after validation. Canary plan: burn-in 24h, perf check, network soak 12h, then production join.

Morgan: Attaching PO snippet for quick reference:
```
PO: PO-172800
qty: 120 H100
split: 72 sea / 48 air (6-unit air canary)
ETA-air-canary: 3-5w
ETA-sea-bulk: 12-16w
bonded-hub: FRA consolidation option, 48h swap SLA with addendum, refundable deposit 2% of air tranche
```

Priya: Once AWB + serials arrive, I'll draft canary runbook and coordinate with installs. Ops: prepare transient quota request for Dedicated (96h).

Sanjay: Will confirm install crew availability and update slot booking API with preferred windows.

Amira (HyperLane): Manifest + AWB DMed. Pre-assigning serials contingent on signed addendum. Will include deposit invoice if you choose bonded hub.

Morgan: Action items: 1) Legal review bonded-hub addendum 2) Finance confirm refundable deposit handling 3) Ops prep 6-node canary and request 96h transient quota 4) Amira to post final AWB/manifest and deposit invoice. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
